terms.title: Imigaqo nemiqathango
terms.s1_body: Ngokufikelela okanye ukusebenzisa i-MyFutureAbroad, uyavuma ukubotshelelwa yimiqathango nemimiselo. Ukuba akuvumelani, nceda ungayisebenzisi le qonga.
terms.s2_body: I-MyFutureAbroad ibonelela ngolwazi nezixhobo zokunceda abantu abaceba ukufudukela phesheya. Le qonga yeyokusetyenziswa ngumntu ngamnye kuphela, hayi ngeenjongo zorhwebo. Akufunekanga ukuba usebenzise kakubi naziphi na iimpawu zale nkonzo.
terms.s3_body: Sizama ukugcina iinkcukacha ze-visa neenkonzo zichanekile, kodwa asiniki ziqinisekiso. Imithetho yokufudukela kwelinye ilizwe iyatshintsha rhoqo — soloko uqinisekisa iinkcukacha kwimithombo esemthethweni karhulumente phambi kokuba wenze izigqibo.
terms.s4_body: I-MyFutureAbroad idibanisa neenkonzo zabanye abantu (umz. i-Trip.com, ababoneleli ngeenkonzo). Asinaxanduva lomxholo, ukuchaneka, okanye iindlela zokusebenza zaba bantu bangaphandle.
terms.s5_body: Ngokupheleleyo okuvunyelweyo ngumthetho, i-MyFutureAbroad ayizukuba natyala ngayo nayiphi na imonakalo engathanga ngqo, eyenzeka ngamabona-ndenzile, okanye esisiphumo, evela ekusebenziseni kwakho le qonga.
terms.s6_body: Singazihlaziya ezi Miqathango amaxesha ngamaxesha. Ukuqhubeka usebenzisa iqonga emva kweenguqu kuthetha ukuba uyawamkela la Maqathango matsha.
terms.s7_body: Ngayo nayiphi na imibuzo malunga nezi Migaqo, nceda uqhagamshelane nathi kwiphepha leNkxaso.

privacy.title: Isaziso Sobumfihlo
privacy.s1_body: I-MyFutureAbroad liqonga elinceda abantu ukuba bacwangcise kwaye balawule ukufudukela kwabo phesheya. Izalathisi ezithi "thina", "sithi", okanye "sethu" zibhekisa kwi-MyFutureAbroad.
privacy.s2_body: Siqokelela iinkcukacha ozibonelelayo xa usenza i-akhawunti (igama, idilesi ye-imeyile) kunye nedatha eveliswa kukusebenzisa kwakho le qonga (umz. ii-visa ezigciniweyo, uluhlu lokujonga, amaxwebhu, imiyalezo).
privacy.s3_body: Idatha yakho isetyenziselwa ukubonelela nokuphucula inkonzo ye-MyFutureAbroad, ukwenza amava akho abe ngawakho, kunye nokunxibelelana nawe malunga ne-akhawunti yakho okanye iibhukisho zakho. Asiyithengisi idatha yakho yobuqu kumaqela esithathu.
privacy.s4_body: Idatha yakho igcinwa ikhuselekile kusetyenziswa i-Supabase. Sisebenzisa amanyathelo okhuseleko angumgangatho weshishini ukukhusela iinkcukacha zakho.
privacy.s5_body: Sisebenzisa isitoreji sendawo sebrawuza ukukhumbula izinto ozikhethayo (umz. isihloko, isaziso sokuvuma). Akukho zicookies zokulandelela ezifakwa kwisixhobo sakho ngaphandle kwemvume.
privacy.s6_body: Unelungelo lokufikelela, lokulungisa, okanye lokucima idatha yakho yobuqu nangaliphi na ixesha. Ukuze usebenzise la malungelo, qhagamshelana nathi ngePhepha leNkxaso.
privacy.s7_body: Singaluhlaziya esi Saziso soBumfihlo amaxesha ngamaxesha. Siza kukwazisa ngeenguqu ezibalulekileyo nge-imeyile okanye ngesaziso esikwi-app.
privacy.s8_body: Ngayo nayiphi na imibuzo enxulumene nobumfihlo, nceda uqhagamshelane nathi kwiphepha leNkxaso.
